0x800136c8.name: entry_point
0x800136c8.evidence: OPEN.EXE header: sets $gp to 0x800403f4 and jumps to open_main

0x80011e14.name: open_main
0x80011e14.evidence: the only thing entry_point jumps to; runs the whole opening -- logos, the movies, the title menu -- and returns to the shell

0x800403f4.name: next_exe_ptr
0x800403f4.evidence: the word at $gp+0, holding 0x800102f0, the shell's next_exe byte. open_main stores 1 through it to make the shell load GAME.EXE

0x800136d8.name: play_movie
0x800136d8.evidence: copies the five-entry, 20-byte-per-entry name table at 0x80011028 to the stack, indexes it by $a0 and hands the name to CdSearchFile; the entries are \\OP\\M0.S, M1.S, M3.S, L0.S and L1.S

0x80011028.name: movie_names
0x80011028.evidence: five 20-byte slots holding \\OP\\M0.S;1, M1.S;1, M3.S;1, L0.S;1 and L1.S;1 -- the argument to play_movie is an index into this

0x80011000.name: opd_name
0x80011000.evidence: the string OP.D, used by load_opening_data

0x80011008.name: title_movie_name
0x80011008.evidence: the string \\OP\\M2.S;1, referenced only by 0x8001273c -- the one movie play_movie's table does not carry

0x80012494.name: load_opening_data
0x80012494.evidence: forms OP.D and reads it in a loop; open_main calls it once, guarded by a flag, before the title screen

0x8001d9f4.name: CdSearchFile
0x8001d9f4.evidence: the routine play_movie hands a filename to; it calls cd_read_directory, which is the one that matches CD001

0x8001f9a0.name: PadInit
0x8001f9a0.evidence: sets the pad buffer word at 0x800a664c to -1 and calls the BIOS OutdatedPadInitAndStart (B0 0x15)

0x8001f9f0.name: PadRead
0x8001f9f0.evidence: calls the BIOS OutdatedPadGetButtons (B0 0x16) and returns NOT of the buffer word at 0x800a664c, so a set bit means pressed

0x800a664c.name: pad_buffer
0x800a664c.evidence: the word PadInit hands to the BIOS and PadRead inverts; the BIOS writes both pads into it, active low

0x80014790.name: heap_init
0x80014790.evidence: stores its two arguments into four globals at 0x80040458..0x80040470; open_main calls it with (0x80100000, 0xf8000), so the opening's heap is the top 992 KB of RAM

0x80014174.name: card_probe
0x80014174.evidence: opens, closes and erases bu00:BASLUS-00255TEMP through the BIOS file calls -- a write test on the memory card

0x80014264.name: card_list_saves
0x80014264.evidence: firstfile/nextfile over bu00:* comparing each name against BASLUS-00255

0x80020edc.name: spu_master_volume
0x80020edc.evidence: scales each argument by 129 (0x7f becomes 0x3fff) into a stack structure whose first word is 3, then calls 0x80029ff0 -- the mask-3 SpuSetCommonAttr

0x800a6f00.name: draw_env
0x800a6f00.evidence: the address open_main hands to PutDrawEnv, with PutDispEnv taking it plus 0x5c -- the size of a DRAWENV

0x80012500.name: init_graphics
0x80012500.evidence: ResetGraph(0), SetGraphDebug(0), then two draw and two display environments 640 wide and 240 tall at 0x800a6f00, and SetDispMask(1)

0x80012644.name: init_sound
0x80012644.evidence: the SPU bring-up: spu_master_volume(0,0) and a CD volume of 0x30 in each ear before anything is played

0x8001273c.name: play_title_music
0x8001273c.evidence: CdSearchFile on \\OP\\M2.S;1 and a seek to it; M2.S is the one movie whose video track is 16x16, so what it carries is the title screen's music

0x800133c8.name: frame_begin
0x800133c8.evidence: ClearOTagR on the current buffer's 256-entry ordering table; first call of every frame in open_main, play_movie and the title loop

0x80013418.name: frame_end
0x80013418.evidence: DrawSync(0), VSync, PutDrawEnv, PutDispEnv, DrawOTag -- the buffer swap that closes every frame

0x8001fe6c.name: VSync
0x8001fe6c.evidence: reads the vertical blank counters through the pointers at 0x8003fa34 and 0x8003fa38 and waits; frame_end calls it with 0

0x8001279c.name: title_layer_a
0x8001279c.evidence: the artwork and the logo: a full-screen 640x240 quad from the 8-bit page at VRAM (640,0), then KING'S at x 64..320 and FIELD II at x 320..576. The argument is the fade state and it returns 1 when the fade is done

0x80012b0c.name: title_layer_b
0x80012b0c.evidence: three strips of the 4-bit page at VRAM (896,0): the two copyright lines, at x 124..379

0x80012ea0.name: title_layer_c
0x80012ea0.evidence: the two menu entries out of the same page -- NEW is u 0..96 of the row at v 16 and CONTINUE u 96..192, each into a 96x8 rectangle at x 272..368, y 190 and 202. The argument is which is lit

0x800131ac.name: title_menu
0x800131ac.evidence: PadRead(1) with the previous word at 0x80040410: a new press of CIRCLE, CROSS or START returns 1 and plays sound 0x3a, a new press of UP or DOWN plays 0x5a and flips the choice through the pointer in a0 -- but only when a1, the number of saves, is not zero

0x800123cc.name: title_confirm_fade
0x800123cc.evidence: redraws the three layers with the chosen entry while fading the CD volume to zero, then CdControl(9), which is CdlPause

0x80013464.name: cd_read_file
0x80013464.evidence: appends ;1 to the name, CdSearchFile, CdControl(0x02) Setloc and CdControl(0x06) ReadN, then 2048 bytes a sector into a0

0x800147d0.name: malloc
0x800147d0.evidence: walks the free list heap_init set up at 0x80040458; load_opening_data asks it for 0x32000 bytes for OP.D

0x8001a0a8.name: GetTPage
0x8001a0a8.evidence: (mode, abr, x, y) into a texture page word; the title screen calls it with (1,0,640,0) for the 8-bit artwork and (0,1,960,0) for the 4-bit loading screen, which are exactly where OP.D's TIMs say those images go

0x8001a990.name: SetDefDrawEnv
0x8001a990.evidence: (env, x, y, w, h) with h on the stack; called in pairs 240 apart for the two buffers

0x8001aa50.name: SetDefDispEnv
0x8001aa50.evidence: the same shape, on the display environment 0x5c further on

0x8001b020.name: CdControl
0x8001b020.evidence: (command, parameter, result); called with 0x02 Setloc, 0x06 ReadN and 0x15 SeekL

0x8001362c.name: play_sound
0x8001362c.evidence: the sound id is in a3: the title menu plays 0x3a on a confirm and 0x5a on a cursor move

0x80040410.name: pad_prev
0x80040410.evidence: $gp+0x1c: the button word title_menu saw last frame, which is what makes its tests edge triggered

0x80040494.name: opd_buffer
0x80040494.evidence: $gp+0xa0: the 0x32000-byte allocation OP.D is read into
